title: An event emitter

solution.solution.lua:
function newEmitter()
    local listeners = {}
    local e = {}

    local function remove(name, entry)
        local list = listeners[name]
        if not list then return end
        for i, item in ipairs(list) do
            if item == entry then
                table.remove(list, i)
                return
            end
        end
    end

    function e.on(name, fn)
        listeners[name] = listeners[name] or {}
        local entry = { fn = fn }
        table.insert(listeners[name], entry)
        return function() remove(name, entry) end
    end

    function e.once(name, fn)
        local entry
        local off
        entry = function(...)
            off()
            return fn(...)
        end
        off = e.on(name, entry)
        return off
    end

    function e.off(name)
        listeners[name] = nil
    end

    function e.emit(name, ...)
        local list = listeners[name]
        if not list then return 0 end
        local snapshot = { table.unpack(list) }
        for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do item.fn(...) end
        return #snapshot
    end

    return e
end

hints: Store each listener inside a small table of its own (`{ fn = fn }`), so removing finds exactly that entry even when the same function was added twice (lesson 8.04).
`emit` loops over a copy of the list (`{ table.unpack(list) }`), so changes made by listeners only affect the next `emit`.
unitTests:
test("listeners in order with arguments", function()
    local e = newEmitter()
    local log = {}
    e.on("hit", function(who, n) log[#log + 1] = who .. n end)
    e.on("hit", function() log[#log + 1] = "bell" end)
    check_eq(e.emit("hit", "ada", 3), 2)
    check_eq(log, { "ada3", "bell" })
    check_eq(e.emit("miss"), 0)
end)

test("removing one listener", function()
    local e = newEmitter()
    local n = 0
    local f = function() n = n + 1 end
    local off1 = e.on("x", f)
    e.on("x", f)
    off1()
    e.emit("x")
    check_eq(n, 1)
    e.off("x")
    check_eq(e.emit("x"), 0)
end)

test("once", function()
    local e = newEmitter()
    local n = 0
    e.once("ready", function(v) n = n + v end)
    check_eq(e.emit("ready", 5), 1)
    check_eq(e.emit("ready", 5), 0)
    check_eq(n, 5)
end)

test("changing listeners during emit", function()
    local e = newEmitter()
    local log = {}
    local offB
    e.on("tick", function()
        log[#log + 1] = "a"
        e.on("tick", function() log[#log + 1] = "late" end)
        offB()
    end)
    offB = e.on("tick", function() log[#log + 1] = "b" end)
    check_eq(e.emit("tick"), 2)
    check_eq(log, { "a", "b" })
    log = {}
    e.emit("tick")
    check_eq(log[1], "a")
end)
